# RS Mahal

> A fully air-conditioned wedding hall for up to 1,200 guests, with 16 A/C guest rooms, a lift and a Lakshmi Ganapathy temple on the premises.

Website: https://rsmahal.com/

## Facilities
- Fully A/C hall & dining hall
- Separate buffet hall
- 16 A/C guest rooms
- Kone lift for 8 persons
- Full-building standby generator
- 24-hour CCTV
- Lakshmi Ganapathy temple
- Mini hall for 200 to 300 guests
- Free wedding planning consultation
- Fully equipped kitchen

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can RS Mahal hold?
The main hall can host up to 1,200 guests; the mini hall suits 200 to 300.

### Where is RS Mahal?
No. 88, Kolapakkam Main Road, VGN Prathish Avenue, Gerugambakkam, Chennai 600 116 (Opposite Kolapakkam Panchayat Office).

### What facilities does RS Mahal have?
Fully A/C hall & dining hall, Separate buffet hall, 16 A/C guest rooms, Kone lift for 8 persons, Full-building standby generator, 24-hour CCTV, Lakshmi Ganapathy temple, Mini hall for 200 to 300 guests, Free wedding planning consultation, Fully equipped kitchen.

### Do you have rooms for the family?
Yes, 16 A/C guest rooms, and a Kone passenger lift.

### Can I book a small function?
Yes. The mini hall hosts 200 to 300 guests for birthdays, seemantham, engagements and 60th weddings, with or without food.

### How do I book RS Mahal?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99400 95042.
